name: @happyherd/cli
description: Thin HappyHerd alias for the bundled upstream Happy CLI

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc --noEmit && pkgroll
scripts.test: $npm_execpath --filter happy --fail-if-no-match build && $npm_execpath run build && vitest run
